name: What type of sealant is best for shower grout?

mainEntity.name: What type of sealant is best for shower grout?

acceptedAnswer.text: For shower grout, a penetrating (or impregnating) sealant is generally recommended. These sealants soak into the porous grout, creating a barrier within the material itself rather than just a surface film. This offers superior protection against water penetration, mold, and mildew, which are common issues in high-moisture environments like showers. Topical sealants, while effective for some areas, can peel or wear down quickly in showers due to constant water exposure and cleaning. Look for high-quality, professional-grade penetrating sealants for optimal durability.
acceptedAnswer.description: A penetrating sealant is best for shower grout as it soaks into the material, offering superior protection against water, mold, and mildew in high-moisture environments.
